pollution.machine.aspect_tank.help: Insert aspect ampoules, jars or other aspect containers into the input slot to store or retrieve aspects

pollution.machine.central_vis_tower.tool: Drains the excess vis of nearby nodes into Infused Light
Scrubs surrounding flux into Infused Dark
Upkeep: EU plus a small amount of Infused Aura (replaces the Botania mana upkeep)
Structure needs 3..8 output fluid hatches and 1 input energy hatch
pollution.machine.endoflame_array.toolti: Endoflame flowers + furnace fuels → mana (the flowers are not consumed)
1.5 mana per burn tick per flower, output into a mana output pool hatch
pollution.machine.flux_fuel_cell.tooltip: Burns nearby Thaumcraft flux for EU; explodes above its flux ceiling

Generates EU while a dragon egg is placed on top
pollution.machine.magic_large_turbine.to: Burns the MAGIC_TURBINE_FUELS map: aspect fluids, compounds and the two propellants
Structure: 1 rotor holder (a rotor is required and wears out while running) + 1 mana output hatch + 1 maintenance hatch
pollution.machine.magic_turbine.no_rotor: No rotor in the holder - insert a rotor to run
pollution.machine.mana_generator.tooltip: Generates EU from a nearby Botania mana pool

pollution.machine.mana_hatch.tooltip: Energy-type mana hatch: uses Botania mana as the GT energy interface of magic multiblocks (1 Mana = 1 EU internally)
pollution.machine.mana_plate.tooltip.1: Consumes mana to accelerate GT machines above the 11×11 plate
pollution.machine.mana_plate.tooltip.2: Speed = mana pool hatch tier; each machine costs 2^(speed-1) mana per tick
pollution.machine.mana_pool_hatch.toolti: Pure mana pool hatch: pays/receives recipe mana through IManaHatch; not a GT energy interface
Mana pool input hatch: supplies the multiblock; receives mana from Botania bursts/sparks and adjacent output hatches
pollution.machine.mana_pool_output_hatch: Mana pool output hatch: receives multiblock mana and pushes it to adjacent Botania receivers or input hatches
pollution.machine.mega_mana_turbine.tool: Burns the 7 mana fluids (100 mB → -8192 EU/t)
Catalyst pairs raise the output cap (black/white mansus, engraved gold + hyperdimensional silver, sentient + binding metal)
Parallels ramp from 1 to 32768 while the machine runs continuously
pollution.machine.node_blast_furnace.too: Runs blast furnace and forge alchemy recipes, gated by the coil temperature
Uses packaged aura nodes as an essentia catalyst, consuming one node every 30 seconds
Converts the node's Ordo/Perditio essence into Infused Light/Dark at ×10
Interrupting the node supply pauses the recipes
pollution.machine.node_fusion_reactor.to: Node fusion: fluids in, fluids out (LuV / ZPM / UV)
Supports parallels and the clean-vis check
See the Node Fusion recipe category for the recipes
Creates packaged aura nodes from energy essence fluid
Per tick it drains the energy hatch's voltage in EU; each node needs 144 × 2^(EU tier - 4) mB of Infused Energy
Base creation time is 30 s; every tier above EV shortens it (ceil(30 / (tier - 3)) seconds)
Cutting the energy essence supply mid-process aborts the node and wastes the progress
Higher coil tiers raise the node's Ignis value, higher EU tiers raise its Ordo value
pollution.machine.node_washer.tooltip.1: Washes packaged aura nodes in place
pollution.machine.node_washer.tooltip.2: Consumes EU and Infused Water to strip one batch of Entropy (coil tier × energy tier × 25)
pollution.machine.node_washer.tooltip.3: Also scrubs a little flux around the machine
pollution.machine.node_washer.tooltip.4: Process durations are random; losing power mid-operation wastes the batch
pollution.machine.pollution_multi_dan_de: Runs Conway's Game of Life on the 31×31 cell board above the controller
Dead cells are banked by age; mode 0 outputs EU, mode 1 outputs mana fluid
pollution.machine.small_node_generator.t: Burns packaged aura nodes to generate EU; the multiplier depends on the node's properties and the machine tier
pollution.machine.solar_plate.tooltip: Solar plate MK%s: works in daylight with a per-kind boost condition
pollution.machine.source_charge.tooltip: Consumes 1 mB/t of the matching aspect fluid to restore 1 charge to the bauble
pollution.machine.tarot_hatch.tooltip.1: Insert one Major Arcana tarot card to authorize the corresponding ritual recipe
pollution.machine.tarot_hatch.tooltip.2: The tarot card is an authorization medium and is never consumed by recipes
pollution.machine.tarot_hatch.tooltip.3: Crafted from an LV machine hull, a sensor, a field generator, a blank tarot card and an arcane ink capsule
pollution.machine.vis_generator.tooltip: Drains Thaumcraft vis to generate EU and industrial pollution
pollution.machine.vis_hatch.tooltip.drai: Drains 0.05 Vis/s from the Thaumcraft 4R vis network
pollution.machine.vis_provider.tooltip: Consumes EU to recharge the nearest Thaumcraft aura node
